properties.name: country.soap.endpoint
properties.description: SOAP service URL, without the WSDL query string.

properties.name: country.soap.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout for each SOAP attempt. Must be positive.

properties.name: country.soap.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout for each SOAP attempt. Must be positive.

properties.name: country.soap.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum attempts per SOAP operation, including the initial attempt. Allowed range: 1 to 3.

properties.name: country.soap.retry.delay
properties.description: Nonnegative delay between transient-failure retry attempts.

properties.name: country.soap.circuit.window-size
properties.description: Number of completed operations in the shared circuit breaker sliding window.

properties.name: country.soap.circuit.minimum-calls
properties.description: Minimum recorded operations before evaluating the failure rate. Must not exceed the window size.

properties.name: country.soap.circuit.failure-rate
properties.description: Failure percentage that opens the circuit once the minimum call count is reached.

properties.name: country.soap.circuit.open-duration
properties.description: Positive duration the circuit remains open before allowing a recovery probe.
